text:
elaine: quick idea 3A show a compact 'autoscale hint' pill next to saved queries in per-route views. pill = est tokens/day + sample rate + a tiny action button 'Suggest autoscale' if risk high.

tom: curious where est tokens/day comes from. live calc would be chattier.

elaine: agreed we should precompute. nightly batch + 15m incremental job for hot routes. show 'last updated' on hover.

raj: telemetry note 3A sampling biases long sessions. use median-trim (drop top 5%) when computing avg tokens/session. also weight by route request share.

elaine: good call. UX: the button opens a modal with recommended concurrency and a cost delta. we should avoid making it too prescriptive.

tom: API shape proposal: add compact string field on saved_query -> badge_meta (JSON string) containing route, model, sample_rate, routing_ver, last_calc_ts. UI parses it. keeps backwards compat.

sophie: telemetry: emit `console.autoscale_hint.view` with est_tokens_day, sample_rate, cache_age_s, routing_ver, and `console.autoscale_hint.apply` when user clicks the suggestion.

raj: caching: include routing_ver + snapshot_hash in Redis key. invalidate on routing_ver bump. metrics: expose heat_cache_miss and cache_age histogram.

elaine: rollout: behind feature flag per-org. start internal + 5 pilot orgs. default show only in per-route saved-queries, not global model list.

tom: accessibility: pill needs aria-label: 'Estimated tokens per day: X. Sample rate Y. Suggest autoscale button.' and keyboard focus.

sophie: docs blurb for tooltip: 'Estimated daily token burn given current routing & sampling. Use Suggest Autoscale to propose concurrency/capacity changes; review cost impact before applying.' link to docs.

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary deploy scheduled for service console-autoscale-hint ref=pr-212 (ns=console-canary).

elaine: i'll draft the API PR and modal copy, ping @tom and @raj for review. thanks!
